'''Electroar''' is a [[Lightning]] type Support [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Zappur]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Blitzmane]] at 6 silver stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Electroroar simply cannot understand why [[Zapooch]] struggles to control electricity. One roar, a casual flick of the mane, and those pesky Zobos are sent flying. Easy."

Electroar is a gold rarity Tatari. 

==Appearance==
A yellow lion with a lightning bolt on its head and bolt shaped whiskers. Its tail is shaped like a bolt as well. It has a white lower face and underbelly, and sports large orange eyebrows and dark ears.

Electroroar's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with off-white.

==Evolution Trial==
Electroar's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 silver stars/49 copies. To evolve it into [[Blitzmane]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Electroar to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Its been told that Electroroar led the fight to repel the hyenas from the pride's rock."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Electroar's mane brims with electric power, leaving blazing arcs in the air. Roars can unleash this electric power to knock back foes."

==Strategy==
[[File:Electroar Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Electroar's attack range]] A simple Lightning Tank, it can knock back Zobos a short distance, helping to slow down the Zobos' progress and group up multiple Zobos together. Place in front for max effectiveness. 
{{clear|left}}
